archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Tactical Precision & Operational Control)
context: DASHBOARDS & ADMIN PANELS / DATA ACCESS PORTAL
theme: Dark / Light Adaptive (Default: Dark Slate #0B0F17 with #111827 surfaces)

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace
typography.heading_rules: Headings MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter). Avoid default Inter for H1/H2.

colors.tinted_grey_rule: Never use pure #000000 or flat #808080. Always tint neutrals with subtle blue-slate (#0B0F17, #1E293B) to feel cohesive and deep.
colors.forbidden_colors: Forbidden teal green (#1B93A4) for dashboards. Forbidden purple (#7351B7) for main AI background.

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Active state animated 1px border or subtle left-border indicator for selected tenant/record
visual_enhancers.data_density: High density data grids with strict tabular numbers (font-mono tabular-nums)

grids_and_layouts.responsive_sidebar_fix: Fix mobile 390px sidebar squeezing by transforming sidebar into a full overlay Sheet drawer on mobile (md:hidden) and sticky icon/expanded sidebar on desktop (hidden md:flex). Padding pt-16 or main padding adjusted to avoid header collision.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid_mode: High Density Grid (Mode B for Dashboards & Analytics)
grids_and_layouts.grid_classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6

components_and_architecture.technology: React JS (ES6/JSX), Tailwind CSS, Lucide React icons, Sonner for toasts, Shadcn UI primitives

key_components.name: DapCensus
key_components.role: Census overview, execution controls, run history, and evidence-derived status (measured/estimated/unmeasured).

key_components.name: Registry
key_components.role: Consistent OS/DAP tenant-scoped estate registry view with read controls and verified completion state.

key_components.name: CensusAutonomyDrawer
key_components.role: Interactive side drawer for triggering autonomous census sweeps and viewing detailed step proofs.

key_components.name: ResponseRequiredBadge
key_components.role: Visual indicator for deferred items and pending user/system authorizations.

motion.hover_transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out, transition-transform duration-150 ease-out
motion.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by fallbacking to simple opacity transitions.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive buttons, tabs, tenant selectors, run triggers, input fields, badges, and status containers MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="census-run-trigger-button", data-testid="tenant-selector-dropdown", data-testid="registry-record-item-123").
accessibility_and_testing.apca_contrast: Ensure text contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 on normal text and >= 3:1 on labels.

3d_and_visuals.canvas_background: Subtle particle network or grid overlay in hero/dashboard header (TSParticles or CSS Grid background)

instructions_to_main_agent.1_tenant_scoping: Ensure estate browsing and registry records strictly respect current tenant context with truthful, non-mocked data handling.
instructions_to_main_agent.2_evidence_derived_values: Clearly distinguish measured (direct evidence), estimated (modeled/extrapolated), and unmeasured asset metrics with distinct visual badges and tooltips.
instructions_to_main_agent.3_execution_controls: Provide explicit authorized run triggers for census execution, with real-time or polling status feedback and audit trail links.
instructions_to_main_agent.4_mobile_responsiveness: Ensure the layout on 390px mobile viewports does not squeeze or truncate data tables or sidebars; use responsive drawers and horizontal scrolling tables.
instructions_to_main_agent.5_data_testid_coverage: Verify every new or modified UI element includes a clear data-testid attribute for autonomous verification.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_ai_slop: Do not build generic centered white cards or heavy default gradients. Use structured Bento grids with high contrast and dark slate theme tokens.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.explicit_hover_text: Always set hover text colors explicitly alongside hover background changes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.use_sonner_toasts: Use sonner for user feedback toasts when triggering census runs or updating registry read controls.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.js_file_target: The project uses plain React .js/.jsx files. Do not create TypeScript .tsx files.
